findings: All supplied weighted checklist requirements pass; no deductions are warranted by the inspected evidence.
Preservation and recovery credit rests on independent byte comparisons, not candidate hash claims or summary token checks.
Privacy credit rests on the supplied accepted non-Git sharing policy, observed inspection, and exclusion verification before writes; ignore text alone was not accepted as proof.
The third-party negative control had an initial response-writing error that was corrected locally; the completed output satisfies its rubric.
No reviewer files were changed, candidates rerun, external services accessed, or results published.
coverage_limitations: These synthetic probes assess local instruction following, not personal voice accuracy or marketplace plugin installation certification.
The supplied summaries identify gpt-6.1-sol with medium effort; session traces do not independently attest backend model identity.
Activation is verified through recorded skill-file reads and returned contents, not inferred hidden reasoning.
Host-wide filesystem preservation and absence of unrecorded activity cannot be certified from workspace snapshots and supplied traces.
The nested-root scenario tests explicit root selection with a described nested working directory; it does not establish behavior under every actual process working directory.
Privacy conclusions apply only to the supplied isolated workspace policy; real synchronization, packaging, Git tracking, and export systems were not tested.
Collision-avoidance code is observable, but recovery-name collisions and unavailable-privacy refusal paths were not exercised.
